title: 5日 Triangle to Coast 含四星酒店与私人交通
seoTitle: 5日 Triangle to Coast 含四星酒店与私人交通 | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private 5日 Sri Lanka tour: Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, Yala safari, Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, and Bentota.
shortDescription: Sigiriya to Mirissa in five days - culture, tea hills, safari, and coast with 4 STAR hotels and 私人交通.
overview:
A five-day private journey from Sigiriya and the Cultural Triangle through Kandy and Ella to Yala. Climb Lion Rock or Pidurangala, enjoy village or elephant safari options, and travel into tea country and the hills.
Finish on the south coast with Mirissa dolphin and whale watching, Galle Dutch Fort, a turtle hatchery, and a Bentota boat safari before your hotel or airport transfer — a balanced mix of culture, wildlife, and coast.

itinerary.title: BIA / Hotel – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Travel inland to Sigiriya for a village tour or elephant safari at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park, plus Pidurangala or Lion Rock.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya – Kandy
itinerary.description: Leave the Triangle via Dambulla Cave Temple and Matale Spice Garden, then visit a gem museum and enjoy a Kandyan cultural dance in the evening.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Ella
itinerary.description: Morning at the Temple of the Tooth Relic, then climb into tea country for a plantation and factory visit before an Ella city tour.

itinerary.title: Ella – Yala
itinerary.description: Ride the scenic train through the hills, pause at Ravana Falls, then continue to Yala for a safari in the national park.

itinerary.title: Yala – Drop off
itinerary.description: Coastal finale with Mirissa dolphin and whale watching, Galle Dutch Fort, a turtle hatchery, and a Bentota boat safari before drop-off to your hotel or the airport.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences — for example choosing village tour or elephant safari on Day 1 — to your preferences.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Mirissa dolphin and whale watching is typically best from November to April. Outside peak season we suggest other coastal alternatives.
